title: Gisèle Pelicot Survived Mass Rape. Now She’s Looking to the Future.
summary: Gisèle Pelicot stayed silent after dozens of men were convicted of raping her. Now, Ms. Pelicot is finding peace by publicizing her ordeal and explaining how she survived it.

title: Protesters shoot fireworks at Albania prime minister’s office
summary: Police confronted protesters in Albania’s capital Tirana after demonstrators shot fireworks and threw petrol bombs.
